players.product: 400G/800G/1.6T data center optical transceivers and 100G/200G PAM4 EML laser chips (via subsidiary Source Photonics)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: subsidiary Source Photonics is one of the few companies worldwide with an integrated EML laser-chip plus optical-module IDM model and one of the few in China able to mass-produce 100G and 200G EML laser chips; with high-end EML chips in short supply and the industry heavily dependent on external sources, it says this gives it a significant advantage in capacity allocation and delivery response. Its in-house laser chips can partly optimize module cost structure and supply-chain self-sufficiency.
